definition: Fresh native process and initially empty per-run WebView2 profiles; zero warmups; post-batch hash verification; OS/driver cache temperature unverified. Runtime file opens after app workspace readiness.
clockNote: Native spans retain exact process clock bounds; frontend spans retain exact WebView clock bounds. Launch markers for frontend events are IPC receipt times. Overlapping spans must not be summed.

cachePreparation.inputFileCache: No input reads by harness before launches; prior trusted hashes checked after batch; OS/file/driver caches untouched and unverified
